prediction_text: Winner: Barack Obama. Prediction: the Democratic nominee Barack Obama wins the 4 November 2008 general election over John McCain and becomes President; the Saturn-Uranus opposition exact on Election Day marks the break with the old order — the change candidate, not the establishment veteran, takes the White House.
